description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPS and Loss Ratio (%) for different configurations of a language model. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPS” and is a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and is a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The line representing “Vanilla” is purple with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreases to approximately 98.5% at 9e8 TFLOPS, exhibiting a generally declining trend. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increases to approximately 99.2% at 2e7 TFLOPS, then decreases to approximately 98.8% at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” is blue with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increases to approximately 99.4% at 2e7 TFLOPS, then decreases to approximately 99.1% at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is teal with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increases to approximately 99.6% at 2e7 TFLOPS, then decreases to approximately 99.3% at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPS and increases to approximately 99.6% at 2e7 TFLOPS, then decreases to approximately 99.3% at 9e8 TFLOPS.
